about_short_description.short_description: Gotrade is a fractional share trading startup that enables 150 countries to invest commission-free in fractions of companies.

product.name: Gotrade
product.description: A digital investment and trading platform that gives eligible users access to U.S. stocks and ETFs through fractional investing, with trades available from as little as $1.

product.name: Fractional U.S. Stock Investing
product.description: A fractional investing service that lets users buy portions of U.S. company shares from $1, including positions as small as 0.00001 shares for supported securities.

product.name: Gotrade Indonesia
product.description: An Indonesia-focused Gotrade platform that provides access to U.S. stocks through locally supported, OJK-supervised financial derivative contracts and local rupiah deposit options.

product.name: Gotrade Prestige
product.description: A paid or eligibility-based premium membership tier offering reduced trading fees, balance growth benefits, exclusive community access, and selected relationship-management support.

identifier.value: Gotrade Investment Education and Market Insights

product.name: Gotrade Investment Education and Market Insights
product.description: Educational and market-information services that help users research securities and learn investing concepts through screeners, curated stock ideas, charts, analyst sessions, and published insights.
